data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Rosalind, which means 'rose lovely'. Roses are a symbol of love, beauty, and joy, making Rosalind and its variant Rosanne popular names for girls in Christian and Western cultures. The name Rozanne carries the meaning “Rose lovely” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rozanne usually hope their child will grow to embody rose lovely and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: Roses are a biblical symbol of love, beauty and devotion. Christian poets and scholars have often associated roses with the Virgin Mary and Jesus Christ; symbolizing purity, the Passion, and the Church. Hence, the name Rosalind/Rozanne is a spiritual reminder of the love, beauty, and kindness of God, passed on to each child bearing the name.
